head_vs_live_e2c: For a player, HEAD is better than the live bots. Games are 1.3-2.3 min shorter, with far fewer 30:00 stalls. There is much less dithering (-0.6 to -2.4 a game) and fewer Wick-only falls beside fit defenders (-0.34 to -0.42 a game). Idle time beside sieges is 3-10 s a game lower. Peel is faster: no-response is -3.3 / -5.2 at novice / adept, and peeler-turns at veteran are 95 % against 86 %. Lone-enemy collapses run 73 % against 64 %, with lurk ganks. Veteran games are no longer worse than pre on pace. HEAD is still worse than live on part of base defence. Fit fighters stand off a hit base 3-4x longer. Unanswered intrusions are +0.75 / +0.80 at novice / adept. Veteran base structures fall +0.84 a game more often. That is a known gap against 'defend their base', not a regression against pre.
